title: Four labor confederations form the Intersyndicale des travailleurs du Niger (ITN)
reason: The opened report describes an extraordinary organizational session, a constitutive declaration, and signing of a union charter. It does not document a public protest action or a demand directed at government; the session’s public access and turnout are also unstated.
notes: This screens out the documented ITN founding session only. The report names no strike, march, demonstration, public audience, or attendance count. It does not establish that no separate labor mobilization occurred in January.
